items.description: One fully-specified row of a facility layout export. Structural parents named by a row are created on first sight; a row naming existing structure reuses it and never mutates it.

siteName.description: Optional human name, used only if the Site is created by this row. Defaults to siteCode.

temperatureClass.description: A zone's thermal behaviour. PlacementRules match on it.
temperatureClass.title: TemperatureClass

hazmat.description: Used only if the Zone is created by this row.

sequenceHint.description: Used only if the Aisle is created by this row.

allOf.description: Whether an aisle may be traversed in one direction only or both.
allOf.title: Direction

direction.description: Used only if the Aisle is created by this row. Defaults to TwoWay.

dockFlow.description: Required when the row's LocationType role is Dock; rejected for every other role.

activities.description: Required (non-empty) when the row's LocationType role is WorkCenter; rejected for every other role.

allOf.description: A slot's physical envelope. Both dimensions must be strictly positive.
allOf.title: Capacity

capacityOverride.description: Optional per-row override of the LocationType's default envelope.

items.title: ImportRow
